cause_quote: The new candidate-matching settlement branch required `initial.phase === "publishing"` or a `superseded` record with `publication-settled-external-change` intent, leaving `prepared` records on the failing recovery path.
user_saw: After an external install put the candidate live while its journal still said `prepared`, `openclaw update repair` reported incomplete publication and left later updates blocked by `update-recovery-pending`.
summary: The fix lets `openclaw update repair` verify an already-live candidate, retain recovery evidence, and clear the update block when the journal still says `prepared`.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent: the parent sent a matching candidate with the original lease to pending recovery, and #165607 introduced verified matching-candidate settlement with a phase check that excluded `prepared`. Later changes added `publication-complete` and retained the exclusion until this fix, whose test reproduces an external install that leaves the journal at `prepared`.
